en: A vintage, black-and-white postcard image showing a harbor with several boats and ships docked near a quay. There are people in rowboats on the water and a person visible on the quay. The architecture in the background is European, with a large building and several warehouses. The scene is labeled with Greek text in red at the top right, and there is a round postal stamp at the bottom left. The URL 'www.elia.org.gr' is visible at the bottom, suggesting an archival or historical source.
